#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

KEEP_VARS=(
  HOME
  IN_DEVSHELL
  TMPDIR
)

if [[ -n "${IN_DEVSHELL:-}" ]]; then
  exec "$@"
fi

remove_tmp_dir() { rm --recursive --force "${tmp_dir}"; }
trap remove_tmp_dir EXIT
tmp_dir="$(mktemp --directory --tmpdir="${base}" in-devshell.XXXXXX)"
export TMPDIR="${tmp_dir}"

(
  trap - INT QUIT
  exec nix "${nix_args[@]}" "$@"
) <&0 &
child_pid="$!"
rc=0
wait "${child_pid}" || rc="$?"
exit "${rc}"
